entities.name: Saniya Habboub
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Saniya M. Habboub was a Lebanese medical doctor. She was the first Lebanese woman to study medicine abroad and to graduate from the Woman's Medical College of Pennsylvania, where she earned her medical degree in 1931. Later she worked with the Lebanese Red Cross.
